sapling.why: the anchor: a bent sapling, the load hangs under its crown

clump.why: the bough end the handle hangs from, its stick toward the sapling

link.why: the vine from the handle over to the load

handle.why: the vine handle, set: a knotted loop at his raised hand

sprung.why: the vine handle, sprung: a limp snapped end

tendril.why: the tendril handle, set: taut to its stake

stake.why: the tendril handle, cut: the stake and its curl

stoneHang.why: the stone in its net, hanging

stoneDown.why: the same stone landed, net slack

hiveDown.why: Matt, 11-12: frame 2, landed with one crack, whole

bee.why: Matt, 11-12: one bee from frame 1, for the buzz
